text: Large Language Models (LLMs) are computer programs that understand and generate human language. They learn by studying massive amounts of text from books, websites, and articles. During training, they find patterns in this data and learn to predict the next word in a sentence. When you give an LLM a prompt, it uses these patterns to produce a response. Prompt engineering means writing clear instructions to get better results. LLMs can help with writing, translating, and answering questions. However, they sometimes make mistakes or give wrong information, and they do not truly understand meaning like humans do.
